samples.summary: Todo checklist items are left unchecked even though the working tree already contains the described implementation
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260809-workspace-settings-owner-gating-todo.md lines 20-30 list three unchecked '- [ ]' items (gate Invites section, gate remove-member icon, verify no other ungated control), but packages/frontend/src/app/workspaces/workspace-settings.tsx already implements exactly this: line 348 `{isOwner && (` gates the Invites section and its query has `enabled: !!isOwner` (line 94), and line 325-326 gates the remove-member trash icon with `member.role !== "owner" && (isOwner || member.user.id === me?.id)`. A reader of this active task file would be misled into thinking the work is still pending.
